title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode11 On Stage Together!

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hi, everyone! Thank you all for coming today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We'll make sure our next show is even better!
We hope you're looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The crowd sure was great today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They sure were! I'm glad our new song and dance went off without any problems, too♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's keep it up for our next—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Miku! Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was a wonderful show! I had so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. Thanks! Are you here by yourself today?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That was a really fun show, you two!
 The third song felt especially powerful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I always get so excited whenever I watch your performances.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Airi! Shizuku! You both came!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yep! Haruka is here too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you for the other day, Miku, Rin.
Today's show was wonderful as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe. It makes me happy to hear you say that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks to you two, we were able to have more fun than we have in a while. I don't know if we can thank you enough.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. It's been some time since I had so much fun singing up on stage.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: After seeing how happy you all looked while we sang that last song, the one born from your feelings, Rin and I were talking about wonderful the power of idols truly is.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Idols really are the best, aren't they?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, since you're all here, why don't we put on another show together?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sounds good.
But before that, we have an announcement for the two of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: An announcement?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. You see, the four of us have decided to team up and form our own idol group.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Your show was so wonderful!
I'm glad I'll be able to see it again!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It makes us happy to hear you say so as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Have you decided on a group name?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yep. We're going to be MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's supposed to sound like we're all reaching out our hands, chasing our dreams of becoming idols, able to overcome any obstacles in our way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I love it! It really suits you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right? We thought it sounded very optimistic, just like us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I still like the sound of MORE MORE FIGHT, though.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you still going on about that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just joking, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wish your sense of humor wasn't so out there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All right, then! Let's put on a show to celebrate the official formation of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You just really want to perform, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, a celebration show sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it sure does.
No reason to waste this opportunity to sing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay!
I can't believe I get to do another show with everyone so soon!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but are you going to be okay, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Minori, but I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks to all your help, I've been able to move on. No matter what happens from now on, I'll be able to get on that stage.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's Haruka for you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I feel like if the four of us are singing together, there's nothing to be afraid of.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, me too. It's a strange feeling.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Let's get ready for the show, everyone! Come on, Airi!
Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: R-Rin, hold on! Don't pull so hard! It's dangerous!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Perhaps we should all follow them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The smiles on their faces now that they've found their true feelings are so bright!
